title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-11-19

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with good clarity (minor cut‑off) captures a high‑energy show highlighted by Cold Rain & Snow, Smokestack Lightning and King Bee.
ai_review.review: The set is praised for its electric vibe and strong performances – especially Pigpen’s presence, the early “Smokestack Lightning” jam and the seamless segue into “King Bee”.  The soundboard source is generally clear, though one listener notes a brief cut‑off after “Dancin’”.  Overall fans rate the show highly despite a few mixed opinions.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for performance and decent sound quality; one low rating tempers the average, yielding a solid above‑average overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced soundboard recording; minor issue noted with a cut‑off after “Dancin’”.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy performance with strong jams and smooth transitions, especially the jam into King Bee; overall pacing keeps the show engaging.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen (organ/harmonica) shines on this night, drawing specific praise.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann's drumming is noted with a humorous reference to his “Bill Sommers” alias.
